ABOUT CIRCUITHUB

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Shape the customer experience. Upload, quoting, ordering and our board viewer on circuithub.com.

 - Make internal tools a pleasure. Our admin dashboard runs purchasing, planning, recruiting and the AI agents that do more and more of the work. Make dense, data-heavy screens clear and fast.

 - Design for the factory floor. Screens operators read at a glance while robots move around them.

 - Own the design system. Bring our brand, components and patterns together across web apps and machine screens.

 - Design for agents. Work out how people should review, steer and trust the work of AI agents.


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - You've shipped full-featured web apps in TypeScript and React, and you can show us.

 - A real eye for design, both UI and UX. A portfolio we can look at matters more than a job title.

 - You enjoy owning a product end to end, from talking to users to deploying.

 - You use coding agents to move faster and take full ownership of what they produce.

 - Bonus: data visualisation, Elm or other functional languages, industrial or operator interfaces.


STACK

 - Web: TypeScript, React, TanStack (Start, Router, Query, Table), Tailwind, Radix, Bun


PAY

UK £80k–£125k · US $125k–$250k, depending on experience, plus equity.

Join Powerline and help build the future of autonomous energy systems.

Powerline is a fast-growing, VC-backed climate tech company transforming how renewable energy and battery storage assets operate on the electricity grid. Our technology combines machine learning, optimization, and market intelligence to help asset owners monitor, analyze, and maximize operational performance in the world’s most complex energy markets.

We work with leading developers, traders, and operators across global electricity markets, solving high-impact problems that accelerate the transition to a more flexible, decarbonized grid.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to design and build an agentic system that can reason over complex data, orchestrate modeling workflows, and autonomously generate insights and decisions related to energy asset operations.

This role focuses on building production-grade AI systems used by experts in energy markets. You will develop systems that combine LLMs, time-series data, and optimization engines into intelligent agents that operate across both: Interactive workflows and Autonomous workflows. You will play a foundational role in defining how AI systems understand and interact with energy assets and electricity markets.




WHAT YOU’LL BUILD

You will design and deploy Powerline’s AI Agents to:

 1. answer complex questions, explain algorithm results, and act as a decision-support tool;

 2. run continuous tasks and be proactive, without human intervention; and

 3. iterate, evaluate, and inference with Powerline data and infrastructure

These systems will operate in high-stakes environments where correctness and reliability directly impact economic decisions.




CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Architect and build agentic AI systems that plan, reason, and act across workflows

 - Design tool-using agents that integrate with Powerline systems

 - Develop multi-step decision systems

 - Build stateful and long-running agents

 - Define and implement evaluation frameworks

 - Improve reliability, observability, and safety of LLM-based systems in production

 - Collaborate with energy market specialists to translate real-world workflows into agent behavior and logic

 - Help lead technical direction for agent architecture and system design




REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience building production AI or software systems, including work with LLM-powered or agentic applications

 - Strong Python skills and experience integrating with APIs and external systems

 - Experience designing multi-step or stateful systems (e.g., pipelines, workflows, or agents)

 - Experience building memory and Retrieval Augmental Generation (RAG) frameworks

 - Experience with Agent evaluation from direct user feedback

 - Experience with Agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Pydantic AI, LangChain, or similar)

 - Ability to operate across engineering, product, and applied AI

 - Strong ownership mindset and comfort building 0→1 systems in fast-paced environments

 - Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and domain teams




STRONG PLUS

 - Experience building systems with partial or full autonomy in real-world environments

 - Experience working with real-time or streaming data pipelines

 - Experience in electricity markets, trading, or energy systems

 - Experience with time-series modeling or forecasting

 - Experience with optimization systems
